name: Is whole-home interior painting disruptive?

acceptedAnswer.text: While any home improvement project causes some disruption, Frasheski Construction works to minimize inconvenience during whole-home interior painting. We plan the project carefully, communicate daily progress, and maintain a tidy workspace. We aim to complete the project efficiently so you can enjoy your refreshed home as soon as possible, with minimal impact on your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: We minimize disruption during whole-home interior painting by careful planning, daily communication, and maintaining a tidy workspace.
